digest.component_or_area: rebar project code-review criterion; phase-boundary enforcement
propositions: Author a project-owned code-review criterion with four co-located subrules that enforce phase ownership: Pass 1 discovers only grounded candidates without assessment or remediation; Pass 2 verifies only atomic validity/impact questions; Pass 3 applies deterministic thresholds only; Pass 4 offers coaching only without re-adjudication.
The criterion itself must emit only grounded evidence findings with no severity/confidence and empty suggested_fix, enforcing model-judgment leakage detection across all four phases.

A balanced twelve-case eval corpus (RP-F1..RP-F6 must fire; RP-N1..RP-N6 must not fire) must achieve across three runs: recall 1.0, false-accept 0.0, agreement 1.0, stability_min >= 2/3, kappa >= 0.70.
Guards must distinguish operative instructions from documentation, require identifiable phase ownership, and abstain when ownership is unclear; unchanged grandfathered suggested_fix is not a finding.

The criterion uses routing with exec: 1-TURN, block_threshold 0.90, and blocking_enabled false (advisory only); single-turn mode with code_review_findings output keeps runtime proportional to one Pass-1 call.

Project scope is strictly .rebar/ assets (prompt/routing/eval), .gitignore exceptions, criterion tests, and docs/llm-framework.md subsection; live operator-attested three-run calibration must be recorded on the ticket.
